subject: Weekend bridge: keep demo live during procurement audit

From: Alyssa Park <alyssa@medallionhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: brief buffer while procurement audit completes

Hi Jonas,

Quick note — we really like the Redwood sandbox and pilot, but our finance and procurement org just kicked off an unexpected vendor audit this morning. That blocks our signed PO for at least a week while legal/finance double-check controls (SOC 2 paperwork + vendor questionnaire).

Is there a way to keep our sandbox and staged demo live for another 72 hours (or a weekend voucher) so our engineering and clinical teams can finish the evaluation next week? If it helps, I can route the audit notice and procurement email to Redwoods for records (attached).

We’re trying to avoid losing momentum on the integration work; happy to sign a small addendum or accept scoped usage limits for the extension.

Thanks,
Alyssa Park
Senior Product Manager — Integrations
Medallion Health

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and for sending the notice. Appreciate the context.

Short answer: yes, we can do a short, scoped bridge so your team can finish the evaluation. I can issue a 72-hour voucher (scoped to the existing sandbox project) or a one-time token grant that expires automatically. We typically do this for procurement holds so there’s no open-ended risk.

What I need from you:
- Confirm you want the 72-hour voucher (we’ll cap it to $500 equivalent), or request the token approach.
- Confirm the sandbox project name (so we scope the voucher).

I’ve looped in Ben (Sales Ops) and Marissa (Customer Success) to approve the voucher and record it in HubSpot. If you want the token now I can have it issued today to keep things moving.

Best,
Jonas Weber
